independent_review: Controller viewed supplied collection, then decoded #32 and #29 originals at full size; reviewed worker evidence and independently sampled #32 pixels.
sample_method: Pillow RGB, per-channel median and exact RGB mode, no source edits

type_ink_measurement.method: Approximate rotate-normalized coordinate v=round(y+0.077x), x45..810; count thresholded glyph pixels per v, retaining rows with >15 pixels. Ink spans are not font sizes.
type_ink_measurement.limits: Antialiasing, accents, descenders, texture, imperfect rotation and lossy decoding affect spans; original CSS font sizes/weights remain unknown.

contrast.note: Reference yellow-ribbon text is visibly darker than flat ribbon green. Do not substitute #017950 for glyph ink or treat its imperfect filtered median as an official token. Final rendered text colors/contrast need verification.

missing_optional_measurement_tools: Python fontTools unavailable; Pillow RAQM unavailable in this environment. No installation attempted. No Arabic shaping or copy-fit pass claimed.
source_search_scope: D:/Instagram plus this component. No matching original editable source located; does not rule out sources elsewhere or in Canva accounts.
